subject.title: All LLM API calls time out simultaneously despite APIs being reachable (multi-agent concurrency issue)

question: Should #43374 stay as the canonical cross-surface timeout investigation, be split into narrower Telegram/provider/runtime issues, or close only after comparable current-main live proof shows the workflow is fixed?
rationale: The remaining uncertainty crosses Telegram ingress, provider transport timeouts, model fallback, run-budget policy, and possible config/default choices that automation cannot choose safely from source alone.

options.title: Require Current-Main Repro
options.body: Keep this issue open until a four-agent Telegram/provider trace on current main identifies the remaining bottleneck or proves the workflow fixed.

options.title: Split By Owner Surface
options.body: Move the remaining work into narrower Telegram, provider timeout, and runtime budget issues once a trace identifies which layer still fails.

options.title: Close On Mitigation Proof
options.body: Close this only if maintainers accept the merged terminal-abort and spool mitigations plus live evidence as sufficient for the original workflow.

recommendation.title: Require Current-Main Repro
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a four-agent Telegram/provider trace on current main identifies the remaining bottleneck or proves the workflow fixed.
